headline: Türkiye and Canada Target $10 Billion in Bilateral Trade
summary: Türkiye and Canada are pursuing a long-term goal of increasing bilateral trade to $10 billion following strategic partnership efforts across commerce, energy, defense, and technology.
why: Expanding bilateral trade agreements between middle-income economies opens new export markets and supply chain opportunities for domestic industrial manufacturers.

impacts.name: International Trade
impacts.why: Formalized economic cooperation frameworks help lower barriers for cross-border exporters and industrial firms.
